adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: Qwen VL 1

api_base.title: API Base
api_base.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of a vision-capable model, e.g. http://192.168.188.64:3001/v1. It must be reachable from the Unstract containers.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Leave empty if the server does not require a key.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name exactly as served (see GET <API Base>/models).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.default: Transcribe all text from this document image exactly as written, keeping its language. Preserve the reading order and layout. Render tables as Markdown tables. Include stamps, handwritten notes, numbers, dates and amounts. Do not translate, summarize or add comments. Output only the transcription.
prompt.description: Instruction sent with every page image.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the model to answer one page.

max_side.title: Max Image Side (px)
max_side.description: Larger images are downscaled so their longest side fits this size.

pdf_dpi.title: PDF Render DPI
pdf_dpi.description: Resolution used to render PDF pages to images.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Documents with more pages are rejected.
